query_concept: invariant learning, patch-level shift, test-time/online calibration, environment inference
inclusion_rule: primary peer-reviewed methods with explicit distribution-shift formulation
exclusion_rule: generic accuracy-only forecasting without shift protocol
decision: ordinary domain generalization or online correction is already crowded

query_concept: time-series conformal, multi-horizon regions, covariate shift, support overlap, abstention
inclusion_rule: finite-sample/asymptotic guarantees or explicit shift handling
records_retained: SPCI, multi-step ACI, heterogeneous-trajectory bands, KMM-CP, FLIPR
decision: coverage calibration alone is not new; support-aware selective prediction remains a useful EV-specific design axis

query_concept: zero-shot, few-shot, in-context, retrieval-augmented time-series forecasting
inclusion_rule: cross-domain or related-series adaptation at inference
exclusion_rule: large model used only as a backbone
records_retained: in-context fine-tuning, RATD, UniTS, VisionEV, MQ-TCN transfer
decision: foundation-model replacement is weak; analog retrieval plus support diagnostics may be viable

query_concept: censored charging demand, queues, blocked demand, waiting, abandonment, competition
sources_prioritized: Transportation Research Part C/D, IEEE, Energy
inclusion_rule: models service capacity or unobserved/lost demand
records_retained: Mind the Gap, probabilistic queue forecasting, serviceability/congestion studies
decision: latent demand is scientifically strong but real-data identifiability is the dominant risk

query_concept: decision-focused forecasting, learning-augmented scheduling, conformal-in-the-loop, robust fallback
sources_prioritized: ACM e-Energy, ICML, NeurIPS, Applied Energy
inclusion_rule: prediction quality explicitly connected to downstream decisions or guarantees
exclusion_rule: post-hoc optimization using fixed point forecasts only
records_retained: Forecasting What Matters, non-clairvoyant scheduling, CP-in-the-loop, EV flexibility dispatch
decision: decision loss alone is occupied; robust/consistent scheduling under untrusted forecasts is more distinct

query_concept: dynamic charging price, incentives, causal ML, policy response forecasting
sources_prioritized: Energy, Applied Energy, NBER, transport journals
inclusion_rule: real intervention or explicit causal identification
exclusion_rule: purely simulated price elasticity without identification
records_retained: supermarket incentive pilot, UK natural field experiment watch, spatiotemporal causal game
decision: high-upside direction but public intervention data are scarce

query_concept: heterogeneous models, synthetic knowledge carriers, joint shift calibration, benchmark, privacy attack
sources_prioritized: TKDE, Science China Information Sciences, SoftwareX, UAI, ICLR
inclusion_rule: time-series-specific federated method or threat model
records_retained: FedMixer, Fed-TREND, FedProC, FCPJS, PiXTime, TS-Inverse
decision: ordinary heterogeneous-model FL is crowded; trustworthy FL needs a precise threat and calibration objective

query_concept: fat-tail forecasting, jump processes, peak exceedance, extreme-event calibration, selective learning
sources_prioritized: ICML, NeurIPS, PMLR, EV publisher pages
inclusion_rule: primary methods or EV studies that explicitly model tails, jumps, peaks or high-quantile failure
exclusion_rule: ordinary MAE/RMSE-only models with no tail formulation
records_retained: MoF, Neural MJD, Selective Learning, CUP-EV, deployment-oriented benchmark
decision: tail risk is promising only as a support-aware OOD/risk module, not as generic peak-weighted loss

research_cluster: power, availability, waiting and latent service demand
query_concept: charging congestion forecast, waiting time, availability, queue, blocked/rejected demand, capacity censoring
sources_prioritized: Transportation/energy journals, arXiv, official code/data records
inclusion_rule: models linking station capacity or queues to forecast targets or schedules
exclusion_rule: pure charger siting without temporal forecasting
records_retained: Mind the Gap, queue-based probabilistic load forecast, fluid-queue congestion preprint
decision: scientifically strong but real labels are insufficient; merge with latent-demand identifiability gate

research_cluster: data corruption, anomaly and early-session prediction
query_concept: EV charging anomaly, missing data, demand-aware monitoring, early-session total energy, federated early prediction
inclusion_rule: EV-specific forecasting linked to anomaly/missingness or operational early-session decisions
exclusion_rule: generic intrusion detection without charging-demand prediction
records_retained: ST-DAD, early-session federated demand prediction, selective TSF
decision: use as engineering assurance or side task; insufficient as the primary station-level research direction

query_concept: physics simulation surrogate, digital twin, sim-to-real transfer, deployment benchmark, longitudinal external validation
sources_prioritized: Applied Energy, ECM:X, Journal of Energy Storage, Zenodo, official GitHub
inclusion_rule: forecasting work with explicit simulator-real bridge, reproducible deployment protocol or multi-year external data
exclusion_rule: simulation-only load profiles without validation path
records_retained: WeTRaC, ST-DAD, deployment-oriented benchmark, Scotland longitudinal dataset
decision: sim-to-real remains high-risk but valuable as a reserve direction; deployment protocol is mandatory across all tracks
